weapons.name: Scalpel Beam
weapons.desc: A short, precise cut that recharges fast.

weapons.name: Twin Pike Beam
weapons.desc: Two crossing beams that sweep three rooms.

weapons.name: Reaper Beam
weapons.desc: Leaves the ship alone and goes for the crew.

weapons.name: Dawn Lance
weapons.desc: A long, brutal cut through anything without shields.

events.text: A crystal the size of a moon refracts starlight into a thousand coloured beams. A research team has been trying to catch one for years.

success.text: One beam lands perfectly in their collector. They give you a spare emitter in thanks.

fail.text: A stray beam slices across your hull.

choices.text: Feed one of your beams through the crystal.

effect.text: Your beam comes out the other side brighter and tighter. The researchers hand you a focusing lens to keep it that way.

choices.text: Admire the view and move on.

effect.text: Your crew take a lot of pictures.
